name: git
description: Read-only access to the repository in your workspace: status, recent history, and diffs.
author: Vesper core

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Show branch and working-tree status of the workspace repository.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Show recent commits as a compact log.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show the unstaged diff, optionally limited to one path.

path.description: Optional file or directory to diff
